records.title: Principles of In Vivo Science
records.header: C MED 407 Principles of In Vivo Science (3)
records.text: C MED 407 Principles of In Vivo Science (3) Focuses on biology and care of small animals used in medical research, and the experimental design and ethics of animal research. Includes lectures and problem-based learning. Offered: AWSp.
